svg.text: FIGURE 13
The Minimum Viable Set: Six Terms, and What They Compose
No system functions without any of them, none is built from the others, and everything else is a composition across the two kinds.
There is no order of rank here. The two kinds are in lockstep, a crossing is a change of role rather than a step upward,
and no member of the pair is senior to the other.
THE SIX, IN TWO KINDS
states
what a system is at a moment
space
near, far, between, contained
time
the ordered succession of differences
energy
conserved, finite, directionless alone
WHAT DECIDES IT
it names what is being measured
structures
how those quantities are arranged
spectrum
ordering, so more and less can be said
gradient
a difference that can be spent
network
that entities relate, and influence travels
WHAT DECIDES IT
it decides what the measurement would mean
lockstep
They alternate, and the alternation is where both the recursion and the randomness come from.
A state with no structure has no magnitude: three of what, ordered how, varying across what? A structure with no state is empty: an ordering over
nothing, a network with nothing at the nodes. So each step acts on one kind and yields the other, and every link in the chain is changed by the
link before it. That alternation is the recursion. And because each turn leaves a remainder (the residual) that re-enters the next, it is also where the randomness
comes from: a remainder compounding through a chain that amplifies is chaos, and the detail a crossing discards reappears above it as noise.
Neither kind generates anything alone. Neither denotes anything alone. That is why they are two kinds rather than one list.
And within a kind the members are distinct too, which is what makes them separate frames.
Space, time and energy are not three readings of one quantity. Neither are spectrum, gradient and network. Each answers a question the other two
cannot: adjacency is not duration, an ordering is not a pathway, a pathway is not a direction. If two members drew on the same underlying fact,
their agreement would carry no information, and one of them would be redundant rather than minimal.
Which is Figure 2’s condition applied to the set itself: independence is how little two frames draw on the same evidence, and it is what
makes their agreement mean anything. Six members that overlapped would be fewer members wearing six names.
WHY SIX, AND WHY NOT FIVE OR SEVEN
Each is indivisible: no arrangement of the other five yields it.
Not hard to derive. There is no route. Ordering does not produce adjacency; duration does not produce conservation; a quantity does not produce
the fact that things relate at all. A continuum was the seventh and was removed for failing exactly this: it is a spectrum without gaps, or
smoothness over space and time. A generating set must not contain what its own members produce.
The gradient is the thin case, so it is argued rather than assumed. An ordering varying across space gives a distribution, and a
distribution is a fact that stays put. What makes a gradient a gradient is that it can be spent, and neither an ordering nor a span of
space has directedness. If the whole carries a property neither part has, the whole is not the parts arranged.
And the set is minimal: remove one and something stops.
Read the established laws of thermodynamics as a test rather than a scorecard. Each member is load-bearing in at least one of them, and the
continuum in none. More laws may be added; the argument is that nothing on this list is idle, not that these four exhaust what could test it.
REMOVE
WHICH COVERS
AND WITHOUT IT
spectrum
zeroth
no ordering, so no equivalence over thermal state, so no transitivity
network
zeroth, second
no relation between systems, and no configurations to count
space
first, second
no spatial symmetry for Noether, and no region to make isolated mean anything
time
first, third
no time-translation symmetry, and no finite operations to leave a remainder
energy
second
finiteness in a finite region is what makes the counting terminate
gradient
second, third
no direction to drive the flow, and no remainder left after each step
The derivations were run before anyone asked for a minimality argument, which is why this is evidence rather than a case built to fit.
WHAT THE COMBINATIONS COMPOSE
Everything else is a composition across the two kinds, never within one.
Space and time compose conservation. Spectrum and gradient compose a continuum. Network and gradient compose a flow. And a gradient over a
network is a different term from a gradient over space, because which structure it is bonded to is part of what it is.
ONE CHAIN
a state
a structure
relations
fields
gradients
flows
networks
and on
Back to new relations and fields, which is what restarts it. Each step acts on one kind and
produces the other, so the colours alternate by construction rather than by choice.
The residual of the turn just closed is what the next turn composes against, so no two
passes begin from the same place.
One chain is one route through a space that has no last route.
EVERY PAIRING AVAILABLE
space
time
energy
spectrum
gradient
network
Every cell is a composition, and each becomes
an operand for the next, alongside the six and
every link already made. The array does not close.
And each composition becomes an atom for whatever composes over it.
A settled composition enters the library as a term, and is then an operand like any other. Which puts it under the same two rules as everything
else: composition never leaves the closure it started in, and only an import moves that wall. See Figures 6 and 8.
So the array is unbounded and the reach is not. More compositions never add a member, and no chain reaches outside what the six and
their bonds already span.
The set is closed. The arrangements are not. That gap is why import exists.
Six members, and no amount of arranging produces a seventh: a new member would have to be a new kind, and composition only ever
rearranges the kinds already held. Meanwhile the arrangements over those six do not run out. So a frame can search without end and
still not arrive: infinite effort inside a finite reach.
Which is why the wall in Figure 6 is a wall at all, and why only an import moves it. If arrangement were bounded you would
exhaust it and be finished. If arranging could add a kind you would never need another frame.
Different routes can arrive at the same substance.
In chemistry this has been established since Liebig and Wöhler found two substances with the same composition and different properties, 1824 to
1826, and Berzelius named it isomerism in 1830. Two chains built from different links may compose functionally identical terms, and the converse
holds too: the same ingredients under a different bond are a different substance. Smoothness, symmetry, chaos and discreteness are each what a
particular composition leaves behind, and none is a seventh member. Figure 12 sets out the mapping and what it does and does not carry over.
WHY THE LINEAGE IS THE PROOF
The array cannot be checked by inspection, so the record is what makes it verifiable.
Nothing about a composed term tells you, from looking at it, which route produced it or whether that route was available. The space has no last
route and every turn begins from a remainder the last one left, so the order is not recoverable from the artefact. It is recoverable from the lineage.
A term carries the atoms it was built from and the bonds that joined them. That record is not documentation of the term. It is the term.
Which makes two different questions answerable, and the second is the one that is usually not.
The first is provenance: how did this come to be, and from what. The second is decidability: given the library as it stands, could this have been
reached at all. A system with a closure can answer that before it searches, and what it returns is a shape rather than a name.
So the system can report that it lacks something rather than producing an answer anyway. Unreachable is a verdict here, not a silence,
It cannot say which primitive is missing, because naming it would mean already holding it.
What it can do is narrow. It can say the question is not one question and must be split before it is searched again. It can characterise what is
missing in effect terms, which is the description that travels to a frame that may hold it. And it can say the answer is out of reach with the
library as it stands, so something has to be imported before it is asked again. Figure 9 puts it plainly: you get a kind of thing, never the
answer itself, and narrowing gets you close while the ground decides.
Which is what a hard decision needs and rarely gets: not only what was concluded, but what could have been concluded, and what would have had to
be true for the answer to differ. The composition is white box because the lineage is, and every claim in this figure is checkable the same way.
The seed was always the seedline.
How to read the claims here. Indivisibility and minimality are claims and both are refutable: derive a member from the other five, or derive one of the established laws without a member the
table says it needs. The gradient is the standing candidate for the first. A seventh member would break it from the other side, and genuine indeterminacy is the open case, unresolved.
